name_reason: Name follows convention data_fd2_battle_<descriptor> (battle core AI state). 'ai_best_spell_target_x' accurately reflects content: the X coordinate of the best (highest-scoring) offensive-spell cast tile chosen by the enemy AI planner. No Ghidra address residue; the '_x' suffix is a coordinate-axis semantic (paired with target_y@0x53C2B), not an address tail. Part of the contiguous sibling cluster score@0x53C23 / target_x@0x53C27 / target_y@0x53C2B / spell_id@0x53C2F, whose names are consistent.
purpose: Enemy AI offensive-spell planner scratchpad: tile X coordinate of the best (highest-scoring) spell cast tile.
logic_summary: Written by fd2_ai_score_offensive_spell @0x15AFF (MOV [0x53C27],EAX) as part of the sibling cluster (score@0x53C23, target_y@0x53C2B, spell_id@0x53C2F), updated together only when a (spell, reachable-tile) candidate beats the running best score (tie-broken by spell base damage). The stored value is the candidate tile X byte zero-extended to a full dword (MOVZX from the reachable-tile position buffer). Score is reset to 0 at the start of each evaluation pass, so this is transient per-pass scratch. Read by the paired executor fd2_execute_ai_offensive_spell @0x1537B and @0x153BC, where it is passed as the X argument to fd2_compute_aoe_targets(x,y,...) and fd2_pan_cursor_to_tile_animated(x,y) when actually casting.
datatype: uint32 (undefined4 in Ghidra; 4-byte BSS scalar, zero-init)
element_semantics: Single scalar: battle-grid tile X coordinate (a one-byte tile coord zero-extended to dword). Not an array.
notes: src comment at btl_aisc.c:636 already concise+correct ('best offensive-spell target tile X (zero-extended tile coord; full dword store @0x15AFF)'); verified store site by disassembly (0x15AFF MOV [0x53C27],EAX; source byte MOVZX at 0x15B31->stored [ESP+0x54]->written here) and zero game-side write outside the writer-confirms transient scratch, not const. Ghidra had NO PLATE_COMMENT but a detailed PRE_COMMENT (deprecated location for data plates per project convention); created proper PLATE_COMMENT via Java API and cleared the stale PRE_COMMENT. No src edit made (comment kept). name kept-rename deferred to Stage 2 if ever needed (it is not).
